name: Displacer Beast Packlord
tactics: A packlord is a cunning creature that often ambushes prey in difficult terrain, where it can use nimble stride and benefit from its great reach. It relies on its speed and displacement to maneuver safely on the battlefield.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

sourceBooks: P1 King of the Trollhaunt Warrens
description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.details: All melee and ranged attacks have a 50% chance to miss the displacer beast packlord. The effect ends when the displacer beast is hit by an attack, but it recharges as soon as the packlord moves 2 or more squares on its turn. Critical hits ignore displacement.

traits.name: Nimble Stride
traits.details: The displacer beast packlord ignores difficult terrain and speed penalties for squeezing.

traits.name: Threatening Reach
traits.details: The displacer beast packlord can make opportunity attacks against all enemies within its reach (3 squares).

effect.description: the displacer beast packlord makes two tentacle attacks and a bite attack against a single target.

powers.name: Superior Shifting Tactics
powers.trigger: when an attack misses the displacer beast packlord because of its displacement

effect.description: The displacer beast makes a melee basic attack and shifts 1 square.
